An Act to validate certain military manoeuvres and field firing
WHEREAS it is expedient to

It is hereby enacted as follows :‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement--This Act may be called the Manoeuvres and Field Firing
(Validation) Act, 1953.

Validation of certain manoeuvres and field firing

THE MANOEUVRES AND FIELD FIRING (VALIDATION) ACT, 1953
THE MANOEUVRES AND
FIELD FIRING (VALIDATION) ACT, 1953.
ACT No. XII of
1953
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons see Gaz of P., 1953
Pt.IX p.72)
[20th April,
1953]
An Act to validate certain military manoeuvres and field firing
WHEREAS it is expedient to
validate certain military man oeuvres and field firing ;
2. Validation of certain
manoeuvres and field firing---------Notwithstanding anything contained in
section 2 or section 9 of the Manoeuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice
Act, 1938, the military manoeuvres and field firing beginning on and required
to continue until such dates and held in such areas as are specified in the
Schedule hereto shall be deemed to have been executed and carried out under the
said Act, and all the other provisions of the said Act shall apply to all such
manoeuvres and field firing accordingly. V of 1938.
